title.suggested: Tom Ryan Recalled Sparring With Allen

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch printed Macon's comments on Fitzsimmons' defeat of Dempsey, recalling that the late Tom Ryan, a sporting printer, had sparred well with Joe Coburn, Tom Allen and Jem Mace.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Tuesday, January 20, 1891, page 8. Current title ('in Prize Fight') is misleading and summary is a raw quote.

facts.fact: Allen sparred with Tom Ryan, a sporting printer, who also sparred with Joe Coburn and Jem Mace

notes: Recollection by the writer Macon; no date or place given.
